about.photo_alt: Kitchen update with new butcher block counters
about.title: Reliable, affordable, and on schedule
paragraphs: I have been doing repair and remodeling work since I was little, tagging along with my father on his income property.

If your project feels too small for a major company, or you just need a few tasks done around the house, I strive to fit your schedule as best I can, and once I start, I make sure everything is completed promptly.
Estimates scaring you away? We should be able to meet at a point that makes sense for both of us, so you get something done that you're genuinely happy with.

estimate.title: Get a free quote
estimate.text: Tell me about your project and I'll get back to you. I'm available 7 days a week, 8am to 8pm.
estimate.thanks: Got it. I'll reach out soon about your project.
